label: copy phase of length-9 sequences, input f/o/z/j
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never on original tokens or <DEL>), almost only for long sequences (L=9 holds 86% of mass, L=8 13%, L<=6 essentially none). It never fires on the first occurrence of a token, so it only fires when the model is feeding back a token it has already seen. Rate peaks at recall_idx 2 (input = orig(1), 40% of mass) and at the last two copy steps (recall_idx 7-8). It prefers inputs f, o, z, j (each about 3-5x lift), then x, 3, m, t; the largest activations are f or o fed back as orig(1). Rate also goes up with the number of digits in the sequence. Copy phase with L>=8 covers 99% of mass but has 5% precision; the token-restricted predicate reaches only about 0.32 F1, so this is an incomplete, low-confidence description.
